verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Smithery itself accepting natural-language commands to operate the product. The CLI uses structured subcommands; its 'find by intent' option is a tool-search feature, not natural-language control of the product. Smithery's REST and MCP connection layer is a building block that lets other agents call tools, which earns no credit here, and the shutdown notice says the API, CLI and SDKs stopped working in October 2026.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
